items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: we played, what was it said then Sunday nights for Adam Nunez.

ctx.x: And I, when I went down further to Beers, well I went across the river, it's the oyster factory
over there, you know, and we played, what was it said then Sunday nights for Adam Nunez.
Did you have any lessons on violin or pick it up?
